summary: Kemeny, Ramp & Renaud is a boutique New Jersey litigation firm (founded 2014 per LinkedIn, 2-10 employees) handling business disputes, estates/trust and guardianship litigation, real estate, personal injury and appeals, with a main office in East Brunswick and a second office in Somerville. The firm is partner-led: Alexander J. Kemeny (Managing Partner) and Ann L. Renaud (Partner) plus of-counsel and associate attorneys, supported by one office manager and three paralegals. Intake appears to run through a single phone line and one shared email address, with no visible web form, online booking or careers page, while the firm is actively hiring two paralegals and an associate attorney and publishing case-law content at a high cadence.

facts.fact: The firm describes itself as a boutique New Jersey law firm focused on litigation in New Jersey's state and federal courts, representing clients in business disputes, guardianship actions, estate litigation, wrongful death and other personal injury cases.

Two offices are published: main office at 7-G Auer Court, Williamsburg Commons, East Brunswick, NJ 08816, and a Somerville office at 210 East Main Street, Somerville, NJ 08876. Published contact details are phone (732) 853-1725, fax (732) 853-1730 and info@kemenylaw.com.
The Somerville office page tells clients to call (732) 853-1725 to make an appointment - the same number used for East Brunswick.

Team page lists 8 attorneys (including one listed 'In Memoriam'), 1 office manager (Donna M. Magrino) and 3 paralegals (Nicole L. Balogh, Mary Ellen Powanda, Andonisha Vertil). Titles shown: Alexander J. Kemeny - Managing Partner, Ann L. Renaud - Partner, James A. Tarella and Gary B. Cornick - Of Counsel, Melanie M. Andreas, Baruch Y. Kraut and Seth M. Weintraub - Attorney.

LinkedIn company page lists the firm as founded 2014, privately held, 2-10 employees, headquarters East Brunswick, New Jersey, 176 followers, and lists only the East Brunswick address under Locations.
Google Business Profile shows a 4.7 rating from 31 reviews and posted hours of Monday-Friday 9 AM-5 PM, closed Saturday and Sunday.
The firm publishes a steady stream of case-law/marketing articles; the blog sitemap contains dozens of posts through 2026, the most recent last modified 2026-09-28.
A November 2025 firm post announces that Kemeny, Ramp & Renaud was 'ranked top three in 9 of 11 legal service areas.'

The firm's Indeed company page (listed as 'Kemeny, LLC') shows a Probate & Civil Litigation Paralegal opening in East Brunswick, NJ at $60,000-$72,500 a year, posted about 5 days before this research.

A Glassdoor job listing for the firm advertises a 'Litigation Attorney - Entry to Mid-Level' role, seeking an associate attorney with at least one year of civil litigation experience for the East Brunswick office.

A SimplyHired posting seeks an 'Experienced Real Estate & Estate Administration Paralegal' for the East Brunswick law firm, covering New Jersey residential and commercial real estate transactions and probate/estate administration.
LawInfo lists Alexander J. Kemeny as Lead Counsel Verified since 2024 in Business Law, Litigation and Appeals, Elder Law, Personal Injury and Probate.
The firm advertises that clients can meet in office, by telephone or by video conference, serving in-state and out-of-state clients who need New Jersey counsel.

operations_signals: Intake and contact are published as a single phone number (732) 853-1725 plus a single shared inbox (info@kemenylaw.com); the contact page shows addresses, phone, fax and email but no web contact form, no hours and no online scheduling option (https://www.kemenylaw.com/contact).

Both offices share the same phone number and the Somerville page instructs prospective clients to call to make an appointment, so calls for two locations land in one queue (https://www.kemenylaw.com/somerville-office).
Published hours are Monday-Friday 9 AM-5 PM with Saturday and Sunday closed; no after-hours, emergency or weekend coverage is advertised (https://www.google.com/maps?cid=16600882020213431461).

The site offers in-person, telephone and video-conference meetings, which spreads consultations across channels rather than one intake path (https://www.kemenylaw.com/virtual-and-inperson-legal-services).

The site has county- and practice-area landing pages (Bergen, Atlantic, Middlesex, East Brunswick, Somerville, car accident, dog bite, TBI, guardianship, appeals, etc.), indicating deliberate generation of inbound web inquiries that must be triaged manually (https://www.kemenylaw.com/pages-sitemap.xml).
The site sitemap contains no careers or employment page, so hiring appears to run entirely through external boards (https://www.kemenylaw.com/pages-sitemap.xml).

Service mix includes document-heavy, deadline-heavy work: real estate closings, probate/estate administration, guardianship petitions and appellate briefing (https://www.kemenylaw.com/legal-services).
hiring_signals: Probate & Civil Litigation Paralegal, East Brunswick, NJ, $60,000-$72,500/year, posted roughly 5 days before this research (https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Kemeny,-LLC).

Experienced Real Estate & Estate Administration Paralegal for the East Brunswick office, covering NJ residential/commercial real estate transactions and probate/estate administration (https://www.simplyhired.com/job/oCwIX_kA5tETkyjUyctxl_Eey0ysoLndTOw-TwdV8p3j0WUHCZtr0A).

Litigation Attorney - Entry to Mid-Level: associate with at least one year of civil litigation experience for the East Brunswick office (https://www.glassdoor.com/job-listing/litigation-attorney-entry-to-mid-level-kemeny-ramp-and-renaud-llc-JV_IC1126742_KO0,38_KE39,65.htm?jl=1010236355484).

Recent lateral additions announced on the firm's blog: Matt LaFargue (Jan 2024), Seth Weintraub (Feb 2024), James Tarella as Of Counsel (May 2025), Baruch Kraut and Gary Cornick (June 2025) (https://www.kemenylaw.com/blog-posts-sitemap.xml).

LinkedIn shows 5 employees with profiles tied to the company page, versus 12 people named on the firm's own team page - the public profile lags actual headcount (https://www.linkedin.com/company/kemeny/).
review_themes: Overall rating is 4.7 across 31 Google reviews (https://www.google.com/maps?cid=16600882020213431461).

Visible reviews center on real estate closings handled by Seth Weintraub, repeatedly praising responsiveness and patient explanation of the process to first-time buyers (https://www.google.com/maps?cid=16600882020213431461).
The firm replies to individual Google reviews with short personalized thank-yous, indicating someone monitors and answers the profile regularly (https://www.google.com/maps?cid=16600882020213431461).
Homepage testimonials (marketing-selected) emphasize speed and results, e.g. 'got results fast' and 'exceptionally fine lawyers' (https://www.kemenylaw.com/).

No complaint themes (billing disputes, missed calls, delays) were visible in the review excerpts that could be loaded; only three review bodies were rendered in the public, non-logged-in view (https://www.google.com/maps?cid=16600882020213431461).
tech_footprint: Website is built on Wix, per the page generator meta tag, and uses static.wixstatic.com image hosting (https://www.kemenylaw.com/contact).
No booking widget, chat widget, client portal or practice-management integration is visible on the contact page; only tel:, mailto: and a Google Maps link (https://www.kemenylaw.com/contact).
Contact page contains no HTML form fields in the served markup, so inquiries are not captured in a structured web-to-CRM flow (https://www.kemenylaw.com/contact).

Google Business Profile is actively used - the owner posted in Sep 2026 promoting a new blog article on trust litigation, and replies to reviews (https://www.google.com/maps?cid=16600882020213431461).
Content engine is a Wix blog with frequent New Jersey case-law analyses through 2026 (https://www.kemenylaw.com/blog-posts-sitemap.xml).
Social footprint is modest: Facebook page with roughly 471 followers and a LinkedIn company page with 176 followers (https://www.facebook.com/KemenyLaw/ and https://www.linkedin.com/company/kemeny/).

A /will-builder page exists in the sitemap but rendered with no content for a non-JavaScript fetch, so any interactive estate-planning tool could not be verified (https://www.kemenylaw.com/pages-sitemap.xml).

Listed in third-party directories including LawInfo (Lead Counsel Verified) and LawCrossing, with directory copy duplicating the firm's own boilerplate (https://www.lawinfo.com/lawfirm/new-jersey/east-brunswick/kemeny-ramp-and-renaud-llc/5d4caaf6-c84c-41cc-b611-f7eeee9787d9.html).
growth_signals: Second office added in Somerville (210 East Main Street) alongside the East Brunswick main office, presented as a full practice location with appointment booking by phone (https://www.kemenylaw.com/somerville-office).

Geographic expansion is very recent relative to public profiles: LinkedIn still lists only East Brunswick, so the Somerville office post-dates the last company-page update (https://www.linkedin.com/company/kemeny/).
Firm announced being ranked top three in 9 of 11 legal service areas in November 2025 (https://www.kemenylaw.com/post/kemeny-ramp-renaud-llc-ranked-top-three-in-9-of-11-legal-service-areas).

Alex Kemeny received a Platinum Client Champion award for 2025 and the firm was recognized as a top New Jersey personal injury firm in 2024, per firm posts (https://www.kemenylaw.com/blog-posts-sitemap.xml).
Hiring three roles at once (two paralegals and one associate attorney) in the East Brunswick office suggests caseload growth outrunning current support staff (https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Kemeny,-LLC).

Blog output accelerated into 2026 with appellate and Supreme Court analysis posts roughly twice a month in mid-2026, consistent with a firm investing in visibility rather than referral-only growth (https://www.kemenylaw.com/blog-posts-sitemap.xml).
decision_maker: Alexander J. Kemeny, Managing Partner (listed as 'Managing Partner' on https://www.kemenylaw.com/the-team; LinkedIn profile headline reads 'Managing Member')

inferences.inference: Inbound inquiries are triaged by hand, so response speed depends on whoever answers the one shared phone line or inbox.
inferences.reasoning: The contact page publishes only a phone number, fax and single email with no form, no hours and no booking tool, and both offices share that one number (kemenylaw.com/contact; kemenylaw.com/somerville-office).

inferences.inference: The firm is likely absorbing document-heavy workflow growth in probate/estate administration and real estate, which is why both paralegal openings target those areas.
inferences.reasoning: One opening is framed around NJ real estate transactions plus probate/estate administration, the other around probate and civil litigation, and the practice pages show those are core service lines (simplyhired posting; indeed posting; kemenylaw.com/legal-services).

inferences.inference: Attorneys probably carry administrative work themselves, including intake and client updates.
inferences.reasoning: Roughly 8 attorneys are supported by only 3 paralegals and 1 office manager, with open paralegal and associate roles still unfilled (kemenylaw.com/the-team; indeed/glassdoor listings).

inferences.inference: After-hours and weekend inquiries are not covered by staffed intake.
inferences.reasoning: Published hours are 9-5 weekdays with weekends closed and no emergency line or after-hours intake is published anywhere on the site (Google Business Profile; kemenylaw.com/contact).

inferences.inference: Marketing and back-office systems have not caught up with the Somerville expansion.
inferences.reasoning: The Somerville office has its own page and address, but LinkedIn lists East Brunswick only and the same phone number serves both locations (kemenylaw.com/somerville-office; linkedin.com/company/kemeny).

inferences.inference: Review sentiment is strong but thin in volume, so reputation is concentrated in a small number of clients, skewed toward real estate clients of one attorney.
inferences.reasoning: 31 Google reviews at 4.7, with the three visible review bodies all describing real estate closings handled by Seth Weintraub (Google Business Profile).

data_gaps: Indeed, Glassdoor and SimplyHired job pages could not be opened (bot verification / CAPTCHA); hiring details come from search-result snippets of those listings, so full duties, posting dates and benefits are unverified.
No BBB profile, Yelp listing, or employee-review content (Glassdoor/Indeed reviews) could be retrieved; only the Google Business Profile supported review themes.
Only three Google review bodies were rendered in the public view, so no negative-review themes or response-time complaints could be assessed.
Somerville office opening date and whether it is staffed full-time are not stated on the website or LinkedIn.
No information found on case management/CRM software, billing systems, or client portal use.
No fee structure, rate information or case-volume data is published.
Firm revenue, exact headcount and practice-area revenue mix are not public; LinkedIn's 2-10 employee band conflicts with the 12 people named on the firm's team page.
Web search providers were rate-limited during this run; findings rely on the firm's site, sitemap, LinkedIn, Facebook, Google Business Profile, LawInfo and job-board snippets.
The /will-builder page did not render, so whether the firm offers an interactive estate-planning tool is unknown.
